answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 72 POA, slashed in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 10 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 72 POA on a stranger, so a farm needs 700 bought sponsors, each risking real money. The comet of the design is public, the juniper of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the delta of honest work is what finally pays.
